title: Atlas M3 Pages human-gate deployment harness
purpose: Deploy one exact frozen ATLAS-WP-010 candidate from a main-originating workflow so GitHub Pages protected-environment rules are satisfied without merging or promoting the product candidate.
invariants: The workflow source and merge originate from main, but the deployed candidate checkout is pinned to the exact candidateHead.
The deployment harness does not modify product source, learner source, validators, schemas, canonical kits or the frozen candidate branch.
The learner root is rebuilt from learnerPromotedHead and must match exact expected bytes and SHA-256 before deployment.
The authoring subtree is built only from candidateHead and must pass the candidate product packaging tests before deployment.
The deployed root contains the unchanged learner index and learnit-next.html plus the candidate /authoring/ subtree.
This deployment is a reversible human-gate surface and is not M3 product promotion.
Explicit human PASS remains mandatory before ATLAS-WP-009 or ATLAS-WP-010 product merge/promotion.
requiredEvidence: PR changes exactly the two authorized operational paths.
Repository governance and PR scope pass before merge.
Main-triggered deployment checks out candidateHead exactly.
Candidate packaging browser tests pass again from the deployment harness.
Learner root bytes and SHA-256 match the promoted artifact before upload.
GitHub Pages deployment succeeds and returns the live page URL.
Live /authoring/ exposes the zero-setup canonical sample launchers.
adversarialTests: Candidate checkout SHA differs from the hard-pinned candidateHead.
Learner build differs by one byte or digest from the promoted artifact.
Deployment tries to use the product PR merge ref instead of candidateHead.
Any operational PR path outside the two-file allowlist.
Candidate packaging tests fail before upload.
Deployment is treated as product promotion or used to merge the product PR.
nonGoals: Changing GitHub Pages environment protection rules.
Changing learner runtime or canonical content.
independentReview: Repository governance validates the work package.
PR scope must confirm exactly two changed files.
The deployment workflow independently re-verifies the exact candidate SHA and learner artifact identity at runtime.
QA-WP-020 remains the independent contradictory product QA after live deployment.
rollback: Re-run the existing Learn-it Next Pages workflow from main to restore the learner-only Pages artifact, then close/remove this deployment harness in a later governed cleanup.
